description: This source file contains the implementation of the ProductConfigItemContentWrapper class, which is responsible for retrieving and rendering content related to product configuration items within the OFBiz framework. It manages content caching, content rendering, and provides utility methods to get content as text or wrapped in StringWrapper objects.
